rows.note: This is the emphatic, all-purpose colloquial way to say that you are starving.

example.english: I've been working since this morning; I'm starving!
example.traditional: 我由朝早做到而家，餓死喇！
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau4 ziu1 zou2 zou6 dou3 ji4 gaa1 ngo6 sei2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the straightforward statement that you are extremely hungry, without the dramatic hyperbole of 餓死喇.

example.english: I'm starving right now and want a bowl of noodles.
example.traditional: 我而家好肚餓，想食碗麵。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 tou5 ngo6 soeng2 sik6 wun2 min6
